Our Story

Where every evening feels like a celebration

“Letizia” means joy — and that’s exactly what we serve. From tandoori platters straight off the grill to vibrant mocktails, every plate and glass is made to be shared.

Glass roof, warm lights and wooden tables — settle in with friends and let the night take its time.
